description: JSON canonicalize. Any JSON document in, URL-encoded as the json query parameter (up to 12,000 bytes), one RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical form out: object keys sorted by UTF-16 code units, no insignificant whitespace, ECMAScript string and number forms, plus SHA-256 and SHA-512 digests of the canonical bytes for attestation. Price: $0.002 per call, paid in USDC on Base mainnet over x402; an unpaid call answers HTTP 402 with the exact machine-readable payment terms.

json.description: The JSON document to canonicalize, as text (up to 12,000 bytes).

name: json-canonicalize
